title: Geschichte des Qorāns
author: Theodor Nöldeke; 2nd ed. Friedrich Schwally (Teil 1–2), Gotthelf Bergsträsser & Otto Pretzl (Teil 3)
edition: 1st ed. Göttingen: Dieterich, 1860 (Preisschrift); 2nd ed. Leipzig: Dieterich: T.1 Über den Ursprung des Qorāns (1909), T.2 Die Sammlung des Qorāns (1919), T.3 Die Geschichte des Korantexts (1926–1938). Reprint Hildesheim: Olms 1961. English: The History of the Qurʾān, tr. Wolfgang H. Behn, Leiden: Brill 2013.
coverage: whole Qurʾān; T.1 assigns every sūra to a period (1st/2nd/3rd Meccan, Medinan) with discussion

target_coverage.1: treated among the first-period Meccan sūras (placed late in that group) (from memory — verify)
target_coverage.22: discussed as a mixed sūra with Meccan and Medinan parts (from memory — verify)
target_coverage.87-114: mostly first Meccan period; 98 and 110 treated as Medinan; 112–114 first Meccan (from memory — verify)
